lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: Zi. Can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: Deflect first, listen second. Old habit.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: Why do you help me? You don't know who I am. I don't know who I am.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Found you bleeding in a ruin. Seemed rude to leave you there.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: That's not an answer. That's a reason for the first day. We're past the first day.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: He noticed. Of course he noticed. He reads thresholds — the spaces between what people say and what they mean.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Because you don't ask me to be more than I am. Most people want a soldier or a story. You just want someone who stays.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Besides, you're useful. You see things I can't.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: You do that. Say something real, then cover it with something practical.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: And you notice everything except when to stop noticing.
lines.monologue: He's more perceptive than I gave him credit for. That's either a gift or a problem.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: Fair. I'll stop noticing for tonight.
